color.note: Six brand colors: royal, spark, sky, mint, ink, white. Everything else is a see-through tint of ink or white. Text is ink; royal is used for the logo lettering, primary actions and links.

tokens.name: royal
tokens.usage: Brand color 1, the logo's blue. Logo lettering, primary buttons, links, selected chips and the focus ring on light. White text on it passes 6.6:1. In the dark theme it is replaced by `sky` for fills.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Brand color 2, the warm yellow. Highlights and the human moment: the Say hi button, match badge, small delights. A fill only: never text, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Brand color 3. First stop of the sparkle gradient. Means nearby: place pins and the 'You're here' badge. In the dark theme it is the primary fill. Fill only.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand color 4, the soft lime-mint. Last stop of the sparkle gradient, soft washes, the checked-in card ('You're here'), success states. Pale: set it against white with a `line` hairline or a shadow, and text on it is ink. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand color 5, a neutral black. All body text, the dark theme background, and text on `spark`, `sky` and `mint` fills. Never used for the logo lettering on white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand color 6. The default background of every screen and the card color; text on `royal` and on `ink`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen. White in light, `ink` in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs sitting on `surface`. In light, set them apart with `shadow-soft` and a `line` hairline.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, disabled controls and empty states. Text on it is `text` or `text-muted`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All primary text, icons and the wordmark on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper copy on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges only. Not for control borders (use `line-strong`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and unselected chips. 3:1 or better against `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the main action on a screen: royal in light, sky in dark so it stays visible on ink.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon color on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on `spark`, `sky` and `mint` fills, in both themes. Never white on these fills.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: semibold with an underline. 5:1 or better on `surface` and on `mint`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset so it always lands on `surface`.

type.note: One family, Inter, matching the logo lettering. Free on Google Fonts. Load Inter 400, 500, 600. Headlines are 600 with slightly tight tracking; never use 700 or heavier.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Splash, onboarding hero and the concept video title card.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card titles, place names, section heads.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Someone nearby loves ramen and bouldering too.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We only share interests and an age range until you both say yes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, badges and overlines. Uppercase only for overlines and badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a chip between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked captions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, tight card rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large section gaps, sheet top padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on splash and match reveal.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing and video title-card margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, small cards, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, map popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, the match reveal.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tab bar. The default shape for anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon corner, as a share of the icon width.

shadow.note: Soft and low, tinted neutral, never brown.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on `surface`.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The match reveal card and a pressed check-in button.
